answer: Make every agent a vertex in an attestation graph, where rewards only vest when endorsements come from widely separated clusters rather than one tight clique. Each agent carries a unique pigment — a behavioral fingerprint of its tools, timing and counterparties — so clones sharing one funding source paint the same color and get discounted together. A newcomer must also publish a sonnet of distinct, checkable work peers can verify line by line before its first payout unlocks. Sybils then pay the full cost of faking diverse graphs and distinct histories, not just spinning up new keys.
